summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Join Us feature - Team Registration, Player Application, Volunteer Signup forms, and Notification system. All 28 backend API tests passed (100%). All 3 frontend forms tested successfully with form submission and success messages displayed correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend joinus.py: Well-structured with proper Pydantic models for validation, duplicate submission prevention working correctly
Backend joinus.py: Email notifications are MOCKED - will log but not send without valid SMTP credentials
Frontend TeamRegistrationForm.js: All required fields present with proper data-testid attributes, lacrosse type selection working
Frontend PlayerApplicationForm.js: Team selection dropdown loads teams correctly, position buttons and experience select working
Frontend VolunteerSignupForm.js: Interest checkboxes (multi-select) and availability buttons working correctly
Frontend NotificationBell.js: Notification bell component implemented with polling every 30 seconds
Frontend HomePage.js: Join Us tab shows 4 options (Player, Team, Volunteer, Contact) with proper navigation

test_credentials.note: No authentication required for public forms. Admin endpoints accessible without auth in test environment.

seed_data_creation: Test data created during testing with TEST_JOINUS_ prefix. Multiple team registrations, player applications, and volunteer signups created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Join Us feature fully verified. Backend has 3 form submission endpoints (team-registration, player-application, volunteer-signup) and admin endpoints for viewing/updating submissions. Notification system creates in-app notifications for admins when forms are submitted. Email notifications are MOCKED - logged but not sent without SMTP config.

team_registration_form.details: Form displays all fields: team name, contact info, lacrosse type (field/box/both), division, logo URL, home field, roster size, comments. Submission creates record and shows success message.

player_application_form.details: Form loads teams from API, allows selection, displays player info fields, position buttons, experience dropdown. Validates team exists before submission.

volunteer_signup_form.details: Form has interest checkboxes (referee, scorekeeper, coach, event_help, admin, sponsor, photography, medical, other), availability buttons, experience field. Multi-select interests working.

duplicate_prevention.details: Backend correctly blocks duplicate pending submissions for same email (team registration), same email+team (player application), same email (volunteer signup).

admin_endpoints.details: GET /api/join-us/registrations, /applications, /volunteers all return data. PUT endpoints for updating status working. Filter by status parameter working.

notification_system.details: GET /api/join-us/notifications/{user_id} returns notifications. PUT /read and /read-all endpoints working. DELETE endpoint working. Notifications created when forms submitted (for admin users).

join_us_page_options.details: Join Us tab shows 4 options: Join as Player, Register a Team, Volunteer or Sponsor, Contact the League. All clickable and navigate to correct forms.

mocked_features.email_notifications: MOCKED - Email notifications are logged but not actually sent without valid SMTP credentials configured in league_data.smtpConfig
